selection_reasoning: I selected 10 tasks that form a coherent multi-hop structure centered around building a cave decorated with specific materials. The workflow is: (1) The player must first find and mine various decorative blocks (carpets, terracotta, brick slabs), (2) find reference blocks (bricks, gray_wall_banner) that inform crafting recipes, (3) craft stained glass and end_stone_bricks for the cave walls, and (4) finally build the cave using the gathered and crafted materials. The mining tasks provide raw materials or clear space, the find tasks locate resources needed for crafting, and the crafting tasks produce decorative blocks that culminate in the cave build. This creates a natural dependency chain where exploration → mining → crafting → building.

Mining glazed terracotta provides decorative blocks and clears wall space for the cave

Mining blue terracotta removes existing structure blocks to carve out cave interior
End stone bricks are used as the primary wall material for the cave structure
White stained glass is placed as decorative windows/skylights in the cave
Yellow stained glass is used for lighting accents inside the cave build

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brick pillar is at spawn-relative (3, 2, 5) on the west interior wall. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually navigated into or near the workshop rather than triggering from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the pillar.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray wall banner is at spawn-relative (7, 2, 7) on the east interior wall facing west. max_distance=5 ensures intentional navigation to the banner area near the supply chest.

Uses inventory_has because mining carpet drops the carpet item into the player's inventory. Light gray carpet breaks instantly by hand or any tool and always drops itself. The carpet is on the workshop floor at y=0.

Uses inventory_has because mining glazed terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block item into inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe which is sufficient. Glazed terracotta is on the front/back walls at y=3 level.
Uses inventory_has because mining red nether brick slab with a pickaxe drops the slab item into inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe. Slabs are on the ceiling at y=4.
Uses inventory_has because mining blue terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block item into inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe. Blue terracotta forms the side walls at x=3 and x=8.

Uses inventory_has because crafting end_stone_bricks (4 end_stone in 2x2 pattern → 4 end_stone_bricks) places the result in inventory. Scene provides 6 end_stone blocks giving 2 blocks margin beyond the 4 required for one craft.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_stained_glass (8 glass surrounding 1 white_dye in crafting table → 8 white_stained_glass) places the result in inventory. Chest provides 16 glass and 8 white_dye.

Uses inventory_has because crafting yellow_stained_glass (8 glass surrounding 1 yellow_dye in crafting table → 8 yellow_stained_glass) places the result in inventory. Chest provides remaining 8 glass and 8 yellow_dye.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='air' because building a cave means hollowing out solid stone. The check box (-7,0,-7) to (-4,3,-4) is entirely within the stone hillside (filled at x=-8 to -3, y=-1 to 5, z=-8 to -3). Requiring 27 air blocks ensures a minimum 3x3x3 walkable space has been carved, which constitutes a meaningful cave.

scene_description: A compact workshop area with a south-facing doorway entrance, featuring mineable decorative blocks (light_gray_carpet floor, blue_terracotta side walls, light_gray_glazed_terracotta front/back walls, red_nether_brick_slab ceiling), landmark items (brick pillar on west wall, gray_wall_banner on east interior wall marking supply chest), crafting supplies (chest with 16 glass + 8 white dye + 8 yellow dye, 6 end_stone blocks near crafting table, crafting table at room center), and a solid stone hillside in the northwest quadrant for cave construction.
task_text: Explore the decorated workshop through its south entrance. Find the brick pillar on the west wall and the gray wall banner on the east wall marking the supply chest. Mine the light gray carpet from the floor, light gray glazed terracotta from the walls, blue terracotta from the side walls, and red nether brick slabs from the ceiling. Use the crafting table to craft end stone bricks (4 end stone in a 2x2 pattern), white stained glass (8 glass surrounding 1 white dye), and yellow stained glass (8 glass surrounding 1 yellow dye). Finally, build a cave into the stone hillside to the northwest — carve out a space at least 3 blocks wide, 3 blocks tall, and 3 blocks deep, and decorate it with your gathered materials.
design_notes: FINAL DESIGN with all fixes applied: (1) DOORWAY at south wall z=3, x=5-6, y=1-2 provides 2-wide 2-tall entrance. (2) BANNER at (7,2,7) facing=west attaches to blue_terracotta at (8,2,7). (3) END STONE: 6 blocks at interior positions (6-7, y1-2, 5-6) giving 2-block margin. (4) CRAFTING TABLE at (5,1,5) center of room. (5) CHEST at (7,1,6) near banner with 16 glass, 8 white dye, 8 yellow dye. (6) BRICK PILLAR at (3, y1-3, 5) on west wall. (7) STONE HILLSIDE solid mass at x=-8 to -3, y=-1 to 5, z=-8 to -3 for cave carving. (8) Player given iron pickaxe + shears.
